note: a with Cyrillic а U+0430 → Latin a
Cyrillic А U+0410 → Latin A, uppercase
Cyrillic Е U+0415 → Latin E, uppercase, word-initial
Cyrillic О U+041E → Latin O, uppercase
Cyrillic Р U+0420 → Latin P, uppercase
Cyrillic С U+0421 → Latin C, uppercase
Cyrillic Х U+0425 → Latin X, uppercase, word-initial
NFD paste — e + combining acute U+0301; NFC composes it to café before any fold runs
missing OPTIONAL diacritic (naive for naïve) — never folded; both spellings are legitimate English, this is a spelling choice, not an input-method slip
